body:
Tech Mahindra, India's fifth-largest information technology services firm, on Thursday reported a 32.7% year-on-year increase in September-quarter net profit to Rs 1,586 crore, helped by robust growth and higher operational efficiency. Profit was up 8.3% sequentially.Revenue rose 15.6% year-on-year to Rs 16,180 crore from Rs 13,995 crore a year earlier, the Pune-headquartered company said.
